summary: feat(settings): animate the Nova auth-flow illustrations
description:
Because:

- The legacy illustrations carry motion (beating hearts, spinning sync
  icon, fading code) and the flat Nova set shipped static.

This commit:

- Adds Tailwind `animate-*` classes inside six Nova SVGs, reusing the
  legacy keyframes; hearts beat, checks pop in, sync arrows spin, and
  the email-code pill, code and arrow fade in staggered.
- Splits the tablet and phone hearts in add-devices out of their
  home-button paths so only the hearts move.
- Adds `Nova > …` stories that pin the Nova toggle on for each animated
  illustration.
- Documents the approach in the design-tokens README.

Closes #FXA-15002
